Bundled third-party libraries
=============================

Chart.js v4.4.8
File: chart.umd.min.js
License: MIT
Homepage: https://www.chartjs.org
Source: https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/tree/v4.4.8

The minified UMD build is included locally so the Statistics chart does not load
scripts from a CDN (WordPress.org guideline: no remote JS except documented
services / fonts). Unminified source is the Chart.js repository linked above.
